༄/ /snga a+thi+-i yo gage in+dasgar chos skor smos bsgrigs/ ༄drag po dbu dgu ༵༵༵༵na pod tshog go/ 34 tshe
༄༅/ /snga 'gyur byang gter chos skor phyogs sgrig pod so bzhi pa bzhugs so//
༄gcaX caXmanga' ris paṇa chen pad+ma dbang rgyal mchog ni/ bod rab byung brgyad pa'i me mo lug spyi lo 1487lor mnga' ris glo bo ma thang du sku 'khrungs/ de yang rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pas mdzad pa'i rgyud 'bum dkar chag las/ spyir skyes bu 'di nyid ni gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍita chen po/ bzhon pa dang 'jol ber la sogs pa'i chos brgyad yongs su spangs pas shākya thub pa'i rjes 'jug bsod snyoms pa chen po/ rig pa dang grol ba'i spobs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po des dngos kyi lam nas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don bla na med pa mdzad cing / snga 'gyur rgyud 'bum rin po che'i skor tsho 'byed pa'ang rnam dpyod 'di kho na che zhing / lung gi rgyun la'ang bka' drin bsam gyis mi khyab zhes gsung 'dug pas de las ngo sprod gzhan mi dgos pas bzhag gcung legs ldan rdo rje dang lhan du bsam yas dbu rtse rnam snang gsang sgrom nas rig 'dzin yongs 'dus dang / 'on phu stag tshang nas drag po dbu dgu'i chos skor sogs gter chos dang / sdom gsum rnam nges sogs brtsams chos mang du yod kyang sdong sdang cher bzhugs par mi snang / slob ma'i gtso bo gcung legs ldan rdo rje dang 'bri gung rin chen phun tshogs sogs sa dkar rnying gsum gyi gdan sa 'dzin pa grangs las 'das pa byung ba'o/ rab byung dgu pa'i shing 'brug spyi
༄tsholtoX rgyal ba nyid las lhag pa'i lung mnga' zhing / /'phrin las mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i rtsa lag mchog gyur pa'i/ /o rgyan rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snga 'gyur byang gter chos skor phyogs bsgrigs las glegs bam so bzhi pa'i nang bzhugs/ mnga' ris rig 'dzin chen po legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rjes 'on phu stag tshang nas spyan drangs pa'i gu ru drag po dbu dgu'i sgrub skor pod gcig bzhugs pa la/ pad+ma thod 'phreng drag po khrag 'thung rol pa'i rtsa rgyud man ngag gi rgyud chen po/10 (1) bde gshegs yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i gang zag mchog gi lung bstan 'khrul sbong dang po/9 (21) bde gshegs gsang ba yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i bka' babs lung bstan gnyis pa/7 (39) bde gshegs yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i lung bstan chen po las gsum pa/7 (53) cho 'phrul 'byung ba'i bka' gsang zab mo lung sbyor bzhi pa/4(67) gu ru'i mthar thug gsang ba ye shes rang gsal gyi las khrigs gsang ba don gyi nor bu/7 (75) gu ru'i mthar thug gsang ba ye shes rang gsal phyi sgrub bskor/7 (89) gsang ba yang tig bde chen 'khor 'o'i dbang /6 (103) dbang gsum pa bskur ba'i rin chen za ma tog nor bu dbang gi bang mdzod chen mo/5 (115) yang tig gsang ba'i rgya mtsho las nus pa'i dbang rim theg pa'i skan sgra brgyad pa/5
(125) yang gsang drag po dbu dgu pa'i dbang bskur bde chen rol pa/5 (135) gu ru'i mthar thug gsang ba ye shes rang gsal gyi dbang gi cho ga gnyis/2 (145) gu ru drag po'i sku gsung thugs kyi dbang /2(149) dbang bskur cho 'phrul ye shes gsang rdzogs/26 (153) rigs brgyud spel ba rdo rje 'phreng thag3 (205) lha dbang ye shes 'jig rten yang tig5 (211) nus dbang rdo rje 'phreng ba mchog bskyed dbang gi cho 'phrul yi ge'i phreng ba nor bu'i 'od zer/7 (221) phan pa'i dbang bskur cho 'phrul chen po rin chen bang mdzod/10 (235) yang tig gsang ba rmad byung thugs kyi sgrub pa cho 'phrul gsang ba'i bang mdzod/4 (255)yang tig gsang ba dkyil 'khor cho 'phrul zhing khams rab 'byams/5 (263) bka' brgyad rigs 'dzin gsang ba'i yang tig cho 'phrul chen po rol pa/4 (273) yang tig gnad kyi sgron me nor bu'i rgya mtsho/6(281) yang tig gsang ba'i man ngag rdo rje'i phreng ba/7 (293) yang gsang gu ru'i sgrub thabs thams cad kyi snying po ye shes rang gsal snyan rgyud kyi lde mig rin chen sgron me skal ldan gdul bya'i don du gdam pa/6(307) yang gsang gu ru'i sgrub thabs las gtsug gtor cho 'phrul gnad kyi 'phreng ba/9 (319) yang tig gsang ba rmad du byung ba'i cho 'phrul las gtsug gtor cho 'phrul mchog gi rdo rje 'bar ba/8 (337) yang snying
༄tsholtoX gcig dril gsang ba'i yang tig rdo rje 'bar ba/4 (353) yang gsang snying gi dum bu srog rtsa dmar po/5 (361) rtsa zhal gyi cho 'phrul spu gri 'bar ba'i rgya can/3 (371) gsang ba thugs kyi cho 'phrul 'od gsal thig le rang gsal/9 (377) yang tig gsang ba don gyi cho 'phrul las phyag g.yas dang phyag rgya'i cho 'phrul rdo rje 'bar ba'i gzi 'od/8 (395) zhabs kyi cho 'phrul dregs pa kun 'dul/6 (411) zhabs kyi cho 'phrul drod rtags bcas pa/5 (423) zhabs kyi cho 'phrul rtsal chen 'bar ba/2 (433) yang tig gsang ba rgyan gyi cho 'phrul gyi gsang ba don bcud gnad kyi bkog yig9 (437) snang gsum ye shes gsal sgron cho 'phrul mchog gi snying po/6 (455) lam chig chod gnad kyi yang tig gsang ba/3 (467) yang tig gsang ba 'bru gcig thugs sgrub bskyed rim/4 (473) thugs bsgrub gsang ba yang tig7 (481) yang gsang tshe'i sgrub pa t+pū nang yongs rdzogs/3 (495) bod skyong bstan ma'i gsol kha legs pa'i 'byung gnas/3 (501) snyu spyang ma brgyad zil gnon las la bskul ba/2 (507) bka' srung gsang ba'i yang tig2 (511)gsang thems rdo rje brtsegs pa'i pho brang /3 (515)drag dmar dbu dgu'i dmigs rim gter ston nyi zla'i 'od zer gyi phyag bris dngos kyi bu dpe byung ba las bshus pa'i ngo mtshar can/2 (521) rig 'dzin pad 'phrin

/༈)rtsa pad+ma thod phreng drag po khrag 'thung rol pa'i rtsa rgyud man ngag gi rgyud chen po bzhugs dra1 su mya ya:
༄༅caX rgya gar skad du'oX ma hā gu ru shri ka pa la tsar rak+ta badz+ra u pa dhe sha tan tra nā ma'oX bodaskad du'oX slob dpon chen po pad+ma thod phreng rdo rje drag po khrag 'thung rol pa'i rtsa rgyud man ngag tan tra zhes bya bcaXdus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i dpalacaX bde gshegs kun gyi ngo bo bud+dha thams cad kyi dgongs pa dam chos thams cad kyi dgongs mdzodacaX rig pa'i ston pa chos kyi sku dri ma med pa dpal kun tu bzang po'oX 'od kyi phung po rang nyid rtogs pa'i gdengs ldana'oX lhun grub rigs 'dzin 'od dpag tu med pa'i rnam 'phrulacaX gdod ma'i bud+dha'i spyi rje'oX dpal chen po rdo rje khrag 'thung ma hā ghu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal rigs 'dzin gyi rgyal po'i spyi rje slob dpon pad+ma'oX che mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal chen po'oX rigs bdag snang ba mtha' yas khros pa'i he ru gcaX sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid chen po'oX khro bo'i spyi
༄༅caX rje slob dpon pad+ma he ru ka dpal la phyag 'tshal lo'oX 'di skad bdag gis bstan pa'i dus gcig na'oX nga bdag gi nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong lasacaX gdug pa'i lha srin brgyad khri bzhi stong du grub pa'oX de las bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad bcu'oX de las dregs pa'i lha srin lnga brgya'oX de las bsdus pa'i dregs pa sum bcu'oX de las lha srin sde brgyadacaX de las ma min bco brgyadacaX de las dregs pa sde drugacaX de las 'dre srin du ma'oX de wo rgyud: mo rgyud: klu rgyud: de bsdus pa gcig tu bsdus shing dril ba ma ning la sogs pa'i lha srin ngan pas 'jig rten bdag tu bzung nasacaX sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i nyi 'od bdal zhing rang sems rang gis ma rig pa'i skabs su'oX srid pa la min gyis dbang byas te'oX sems can thams cad la mgon medacaX skyabs gnas ma mchis pa'i dus na nyag gcig gi
dgongs pa ye sangs rgyas pa'i ston pa kun tu bzang pos rigs drug gi yul du thub pa chen po drug tu sprul nas4༷༷ so so'i gnas su chos ston pa'i tshegiX mi'i thub pa shākya thub pas4༷༷ dga' ldan dang wa ra na si bya rgod phung po'i ri rnams su chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas4༷༷ rgya gar zhes bya ba'i yul ri med pa rdo rje gdan gyi nub phyogs dpal o rgyan gyi yul4༷༷ 'dzam gling pa'i lte ba la chos kyi srid chags nas4༷༷ rgya po dza'i khang thog tu dpal rdzogs pa chen po'i bka' babs nas4༷༷ rgya gar chos kyi thub pa la4༷༷ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i tshe na4༷༷ bod yul srin po gdong dmar gyi skabs su sangs rgyas kyis zhabs kyis ma bcags pas4༷༷ yul dus du zhal gyi ma gzigs na'ang dur khrod chen po brgyad du byed dgas phyed las4༷༷ dam pa'i chos ni srid pa mun pa'i dmag rum mkhyag pa 'khyag yul gyi mtha' khob tu srid dogiX bstan pa gcig la ston pa gcig gi ma khyab pa'i tshe na4༷༷ ston pa shākya thub pa sku mya ngan las te4༷༷ 'das pa'i dus na zhal gyis 'das rjes sugiX nga ni mya ngan 'das pa'i dus shes na4༷༷ lo ni nyis brgya lnga bcu na4༷༷ rgyal tshab dga' rab rdo rje 'byung ltoX pad+ma 'byung gnas ma byung b.raltoX khyod kyi thub pa'i rgyal tshab gyis4༷༷ de nas nga yis rgyal tshab nyidagiX pad+ma 'byung gnas shes bya bltoX skye 'chi med pa'i sprul sku 'byung ltoX sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i dpal4༷༷ thub pa'i rgyal tshab don gsum pagiX
༄tshiltoX sangs rgyas kun gyi sras gcig po4༷༷ bka' mdo lung gsum chos kyi mdzodagiX nga yis bstan 'jug des skyong ngo ltoX nga yis zhabs kyi ma bcag pa'igiX 'dzam gling bod khams gling bzhi sogs4༷༷ sprul sku de yis zhabs kyis bcags4༷༷ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i nyi 'od bdal4༷༷ nga yis chos rnams kun gyi lung ltoX man ngag skyes bu de yis bstan4༷༷ nga yis chos srid bstan pa yis4༷༷ ma khyab bod khams mun rum dugiX dam chos sgron me sprul skus sporaltoXthub pa'i bstan pa bod yul dugiX o rgyan pad+ma nyid kyis skyong ltoX bod du chos kyi rgyal srid daraltoX rgya gar ston pa shāka thub la4༷༷ bod kyi ston pa o rgyan nyidagiX o rgyan pad+ma zhes bya bltoX kun tu bzang po'i ngo bo nyidagiX rdo rdze 'chang chen sprul pa'i skugiX rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i dpal4༷༷ rigs gsum mgon po'i rang bzhinate4༷༷ snang ba mtha' yas sprul pa'i skugiX thugs rdze chen po mngon sum nyidagiX bdag cag thub pa drug gi skugiX gcig tu sprul pa'i sras gcig po4༷༷ ma 'ongs sems can maskyurdzon gcig yin4༷༷ sangs rgyas stong gi gdung gcig po4༷༷ dus gsum bud+dha spyi 'dus dpal4༷༷ bde gshegs thams cad sku gsum rjesags4༷༷ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin te4༷༷ lo ni sum stong drug brgya na4༷༷ dha na ko sha'i mtsho las 'khrungs4༷༷ de dus thub pa'i bstan pa daraltoX rgyal tshab dga' rab rdo rje gung gshegs tshegiX thugs mdzod man ngag 'di la gtodagiX bstan pa'i bdag
por khyedadabang bkuraltoX bod du chos kyi bstan pa skyong ltoX bdug pa srin gyi kha gnon mdzodagiX ces thub pas lung ba stan te4༷༷ rtsa rgyud man ngag gi tan+t+ra las4༷༷ sangs rgyas kyi lung bstan pa'i le'u ste dang po'ogiX mya/ o rgyan gyi skad dugiX ma hā ghu ru rak+ta ka ya wakyi ta bud+dha tan+t+ra nā mgiX bod skad du slob dpon chen po rdo rje drag po khrag 'thung rol pa'i rtsa rgyudagiX sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gcig dril gyi rgyud ces bya bltoX thub pa'i zhal skyin sangs rgyas 'od dpag med snang ba mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal 'ordzoltoX rgya gar ston pa shākya thub pa dgagiX 'das rjes rgyal tshab dam pa'i sras gcig po4༷༷ bod yul khis rgyan bod kun rnams kyis4༷༷ ston pa'i zhal tshab sangs rgyas sras gcig po4༷༷ sprul sku'i shākya'i rgyal tshab ma hā ghu ru nyidagiX stonapa'i lung 'dzin dus la babs pa'i tshegiX nyid las mi bzhan ston pa kun bzang kyis4༷༷ bde ba can dang ri bo ta la dang ltoX sprul sku'i zhing dang longs sku'i gzhal yas dang ltoX chos sku'i pho brang kun tu 'od zer bskye4༷༷ bstan pa'i gdung 'dzin shākya'i rgyal po yigiX 'das rjes rgyal tshab 'gro ba'i mgon gcig po4༷༷skye lkaṃ med pa'i sprul sku ston gcig po4༷༷ sangs rgyas stong gi mthu bsdus nga sprul gcigagiX ces bsgos pa dang ltoX sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi thugs ka nas hriXdamar po bskal pa dang po'i khru gang pa 'od zer 'bar ba la rigs lnga'i sa bon dang sku gsung thugs kyi yi
༄tsholtoX ge dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa bon dang bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi srog snying dang brnya thams cad kyi snying po dang zhi ba thams cad kyi thugs rje dang khro bo thams cad kyi mthu stobs dang bla ma thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang ḍāk+ki thams cad kyi mthu rtsal bsdus nas hriX la thim pas4༷༷ hriX skar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin rgyangs kyis 'phangs pas dha na ko sha'i mtsho la thimagiX mtsho la 'od zer snang srid khyab pa byung ngo ltoX de'i dus su bde ba chen po'i rgyud gsungs4༷༷ de nas rgya mtsho la rlung shugs rdo rdze rgya gram las srid pa'i thugs rjes me tog u dum 'bar bar rab tu 'khrungs pa'i dus sugiX gsang sngags bka' 'dus rgya mtsho'i rgyud gsungasate zug pa rtsa ba'i rgyudagiX 'dres pa sdong po'i rgyud gdengs pa yal ga'i rgyudagiX gsal ba me tog gi rgyudagiX rgyas pa lo ma'i rgyudagiX smon pa 'bras bu'i rgyud rnams gsungs sogiX de nas pad+ma go sar de las pad+ma 'byung gnas sku 'khrungs pas mtshan gyis khye'u mtsho las skyes pas dgongs 'dus mtsho skyes rdo rje'i rgyud gsungs pad+ma khye'u bcas pa o rgyan rgyal pos rnyed pas pad phreng gi rtsa rgyud skyes rabs kyis rgyud gsungs4༷༷ de'i dus chos la dka' ba bcu gsum mdzad pa bcu gcig spyad pas dam chos 'dus pa'i rgyud gsungs de las yi dam lha'i grub pa brnyes pas bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyud gsungs4༷༷ 'das dang ma 'ongs da
ltar mkhyen pas bla ma sku gsum gyi rgyud gsungs4༷༷ rgyal srid chos kyi srid du bskyangs pas pad+ma bka'i thang yig gsungs4༷༷ bod 'dul ba'i ston par mnga' gsol bas zab mo lnga ldan gyi rgyud gsungs4༷༷ ting 'dzin rgyal po'i sku bstan pas ting 'dzin rol pa'i rtsa rgyud gsungs4༷༷ spyi rgyud 'bum sde sa ya dgos rgyud gsum 'bum nyi khri khyad par gyi rgud brgya rtsa brgyadagiX yang snying rnam par sku gsum grangs tshan brgyadagiX de kho na nyid kyi rgyud thod phreng rtsal rtsa ba'i rgyudagiX khros pas khrag 'thung rol pa'i rgyud 'gro don bde ba chen po'i rgyud rnams gsungs sogiX rtsa rgyud man ngag gi tan dra las4༷༷ pad+ma las byung nas sangs rgyas bstan pa gnas pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'ogiXagiX bod kyi skad du ghu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi rtsa rgyudagiX thod phreng rtsal rtsa ba'i rgyud ces bya ba bla ma'i thugs sgrub gsang ba 'dus pa la phyag 'tshal lo4༷༷ lnga brgya dus kyi mthar bcom ldan 'das 'das pa'i tshegiX thub pa'i rgyal tshab bstan pa skyong ba na4༷༷ de tshe blo dman dad can ji ltar bca'agreX ces gsol pa las lnga brgya ni dus kyi snyigs ma'ogiX bcom ldan 'das ni shākya thub pa'ogiX 'das ni sku mya ngan las 'das pa'igiX thub pa'i rgyal tshab ni pad+ma 'byung gnas sogiX rgyal tshab la skye lha med pa dgongs pa ni bstan pa la bar chad mi 'byung ba'ogiX bstan pa skyong ba ni bcom ldan 'das kyis rgya gar du bskyangs kyang bod du ma bskyangs pas o rgyan dang bod du
